title: Output on a unary natural encoding
statement: For every natural number $j$ and finite Boolean word $w$, feeding the one-pass transducer that starts in the true state, has transition $(q,b)\mapsto q\wedge b$, and emits true exactly when $q\wedge b$ is true the concatenation of $j$ true bits, one false bit, and $w$ produces exactly $j$ true bits.
